source.title: Old and new unsolved problems in plane geometry and number theory

trace.notes: Input URL https://zbmath.org/1040091 is a zbMATH resolver page. Direct page fetch returned a Cloudflare challenge/403, so the zbMATH REST API was used for identity metadata only. The API record identifies Zbl 0882.00003 / internal id 1040091 as Victor Klee and Stan Wagon, Old and new unsolved problems in plane geometry and number theory, German translation published by Birkhauser in 1997, with keywords including unsolved problems, plane geometry, and number theory.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged for the zbMATH web page, followed by paywalled_or_restricted/metadata_only recovery results. Exact-work recovery checked AMS Bookstore/eBooks records for DOL/11, Open Library edition OL1569909M, WorldCat OCLC 1150972837, and Internet Archive item oldnewunsolvedpr0000klee. These candidates confirm the same title/authors/ISBN or OCLC but expose only catalog, bookstore, table-of-contents, preface/index, or access-restricted borrower pages; they do not provide readable full text containing the problem statements.
No readable PDF or HTML full-text source was resolved, so no document map could be built.
Saved result to outputs/parse-paper/1040091.json and outputs/latest.json.
